name: wiki-guard
description: Enforces the personal wiki's edit rules at tool-call time: raw/ is immutable, log.md is append-only, public pages never wikilink local-only pages, and git commit waits for bin/wikilint.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Refuse wiki edits that break its rules (raw/ immutable, log.md append-only, no local-only wikilinks in committed pages, lint before commit). Off: every call passes through.
